create_fixture_empire = {
	create_country = {
		name = "NAME_Fixture_Empire"
		type = default
		flag = {
			icon = { category = "synthetic" file = "flag_synthetic_1.dds" }
			background = { category = "backgrounds" file = "00_solid.dds" }
			colors = { "fixture_red" "fixture_red" "null" "null" }
		}
		effect = {
			set_country_flag = fixture_empire
		}
	}
	# The effect the capital calls also reads the capital's own star flag.
	if = {
		limit = { has_star_flag = fixture_beacon }
		set_global_flag = fixture_capital_made
	}
}
